summary: Iteration 82 — Credit top-up system (packs + custom amount + splash + admin editor), Stripe Connect payout run, monthly template subscriptions, Dev-OS guide 2-column credit table, Pricing hosting section. Backend pytest: 16/16 pass (~7s, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration82_credit_topup.py). Frontend Playwright verified: (a) /dev-os-guide cost table has ONLY 3 columns Task/You pay/Credits with NO 'Base $', @devmanager present, @architect+@qa NOT present; (b) /pricing pricing-hosting-section renders 3 tiers — Shared ($Included), Pro Database ($19/mo), Dedicated ($99/mo) — with correct data-testids; (c) Credit splash renders after ~1.5s post-login for raj+priya, shows 6 pack cards p100..p5000, promo banner data-testid credit-splash-banner, TWO '20% more' badges on p2500/p5000 with strikethrough base credits (2,500→3,000, 5,000→6,000), custom amount input computes 'Buy N credits' label live ($20 → 100 credits), close X sets sessionStorage tn-credit-splash=1, reload same session does NOT re-open the splash; (d) Clicking credit-pack-buy-p100 successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_* (verified URL, did NOT complete payment); (e) Admin specials editor at /market/review as amit: credit-specials-card visible with promo-enabled-toggle (Splash ON/OFF), promo-banner-input, promo-title-input, 6 rows of pack-credits-N/pack-price_usd-N/pack-bonus_pct-N inputs, pack-add + pack-remove-N work (added a 7th then removed it back to 6), promo-save PATCH /api/admin/billing-settings 200 → GET /billing/credit-packs reflects TEST banner + p100 bonus_pct=10 → restore succeeds; (f) Payout run button (payout-run-btn on payout-run-card) clicks and the button resets from 'Running…' to 'Run payout now' (backend POST /api/market/admin/payout-run returned 200 with results list). Backend endpoint validations verified via pytest: 6 packs with correct bonus math (p2500→3000, p5000→6000), unknown pack_id→404, custom_amount<5→400, custom_amount 50→250 credits, webhook /webhook/stripe with fake Stripe-Signature + {type:checkout.session.completed, data.object.id=<sid>, payment_status:paid} returns 200 {product:'credit_topup'} and adds exactly +100 credits to workspace_billing.credits_purchased_extra, GET /billing/credits/status/{sid} returns paid, repeat webhook is idempotent (balance unchanged), non-admin PATCH /admin/billing-settings 403, non-platform-admin POST /market/admin/payout-run 403 (raj), monthly template checkout marks is_subscription=true (verified directly against payment_transactions collection). Regression: /market/templates returns 14 templates, free install works and returns project_id, /billing/plans 200, /public/credit-pricing credit_margin_pct still 0.40.

minor.issue: Returns 404 even for freshly-installed projects owned by the same user (verified: raj installed a free template → project_id returned → DELETE 404). Cleanup had to be done via direct DB delete. Not blocking, but the frontend cannot cleanly delete a mis-installed template project.

issues: The ChangelogModal ('What's new') and the CreditSplash both auto-open post-login and visually overlap for a first-time user (splash z-70 sits above the changelog dialog, but a11y console warning fires: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users'). Not a blocker — force-clicking a splash pack still goes to Stripe — but consider staggering: only show credit splash after the changelog is dismissed, or vice-versa.

action_items: LOW: Consider staggering ChangelogModal and CreditSplash so they don't visually stack on first login (both auto-open ~1-2s after mount). Not blocking.
LOW: Fix DELETE /api/dev-os/projects/{id} returning 404 for the installer's own just-installed project (may be a route-ordering or workspace-scoping bug).
LOW: Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to the ChangelogModal DialogContent to silence the accessibility console warning (carry-over from iteration 80).
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py:597 uses `obj.to_dict() if hasattr(obj, 'to_dict') else dict(obj)` — this is the correct fix for the iteration-81 StripeObject.get() bug; the webhook now processes unsigned emergent-proxy events cleanly (verified via pytest test_webhook_adds_credits_and_idempotent).

billing.py:568 credits_topup_status: relies on _session_status_with_retry in template_market for the Stripe fallback. The path is only exercised when the webhook has NOT yet fired — happy path is the webhook.
billing.py:530 payment_transactions insert on credit topup: `session_id` is used as the natural key (no `id` field). Consistent with template_market. Good.
billing_settings.py DEFAULTS.credit_promo.enabled=True in code, but the live doc value can be toggled off via admin editor — verified round-trip works.
CreditSplash.jsx L36 useEffect dep array is empty (with eslint-disable) — deliberate to only run on mount. OK.
CreditSplash.jsx L38-47 promo.enabled check honored — when admin toggles enabled=false, splash does NOT auto-open (verified via UI round-trip during admin editor test).

template_market.py:340-366 monthly subscription checkout: on Stripe exception it falls back to one-time (emergentintegrations one-shot). is_subscription flag correctly reflects which mode was used — verified true for the successful subscription call on Helpdesk Pro. Good defensive design.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for iteration-82 scope — splash render + dismiss + session persistence + custom amount live math + Buy→Stripe redirect ✓, admin specials editor round-trip + restore ✓, payout run button ✓, /dev-os-guide 3-col table + @devmanager-only ✓, /pricing hosting section ✓

test_credentials: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 (PLATFORM ADMIN + workspace owner), raj@demo.team / Demo@2026 (member), priya@demo.team / Demo@2026 (workspace admin).
seed_data_creation: One 'p100' credit-topup payment_transaction created for raj by the pytest webhook idempotency test and marked processed/paid (+100 credits applied to workspace_billing.credits_purchased_extra). Also 3 additional 'initiated' credit-topup payment_transactions from other pytest cases + 1 Stripe subscription session from monthly template checkout test (safe to prune; all metadata.source='credit_topup' or 'template_market'). One free template installed by raj+deleted (dev_projects.b7eadb8d-...). Admin specials round-trip left everything RESTORED to originals (banner='Spending $500+ on credits? Big packs come with 20% bonus credits.', p100 bonus=0, splash enabled=True, 6 packs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration82_credit_topup.py (16 tests, ~7s, no LLM calls). Run: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 python -m pytest tests/test_iteration82_credit_topup.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration82.xml`. Uses Bearer-token auth (not cookies) since cookies are Secure. The webhook idempotency test writes to raj's workspace credits (+100); harmless. If splash tests need re-running, first `sessionStorage.removeItem('tn-credit-splash')` in the browser or use a fresh incognito. Iteration-81's stripe .get() bug is FIXED in this iteration (billing.py:597 and template_market.py:313 both use obj.to_dict/dict(obj)+.get()). Iteration-80's tn-next-path safeNextPath bug is orthogonal to iteration 82 — not re-tested here (not in scope). Also note: admin's workspace credits balance was 13,701 during testing (main agent noted +3000 top-up during dev). Not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. All iteration-82 features (credit packs endpoint, checkout, webhook+idempotency+topup, admin specials editor round-trip, payout run, monthly subscription checkout with is_subscription flag, dev-os-guide 2-column table, pricing hosting section) verified end-to-end. Iteration-81's critical StripeObject.get() bug is FIXED and the fix is now covered by test_webhook_adds_credits_and_idempotent.
